changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'MapRuleItem') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[MapRuleItem]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [SourceOwner] [varchar](50) NULL, [SourceOwnerID] [int] NULL, [SourceFusionAttributeID] [int] NOT NULL, [TargetOwner] [varchar](50) NULL, [TargetOwnerID] [int] NULL, [TargetFusionAttributeID] [int] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [Owner] [varchar](100) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MapRuleItem] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MapRuleItem_SourceFusionAttributeID_TargetFusionAttributeID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MapRuleItem_SourceFusionAttributeID_TargetFusionAttributeID] ON [dbo].[MapRuleItem] ( [SourceFusionAttributeID] ASC, [TargetFusionAttributeID] ASC ) END
